features.name: guided corridor route
features.notes: single directed route through one continuous space; visually gated against backward travel
features.quote: Guided Corridor: A single directed route through one continuous space, gated so the player can't wander backward.

features.name: exploration trail
features.quote: Exploration Trail: A walkable route threading the space

features.name: directed point of interest
features.notes: positioned along the route as a visible destination
features.quote: Directed Point of Interest: A ruin, vista, or structure that pulls the player toward it

features.name: environmental danger
features.notes: such as chasms, rapids, or lava fields beside or across the route
features.quote: Environmental Danger: Chasms, rapids, or lava fields that punish careless traversal.

features.name: mountain terrain relief
features.quote: Terrain Relief: Natural landform shaping the ground: hills, mountains, cliffs, a valley, or a canyon.
